tweet_summary: Football transfer-rumor account indykaila claims Xabi Alonso's reps told Liverpool that Chelsea are making enquiries, and that his first choice is Liverpool.
why_note_decision: This is a transfer rumor from an aggregator account. Fabrizio Romano in May 2026 confirms Chelsea met directly with Alonso and Liverpool has not approached his camp — but Romano cannot rule out that Alonso's reps did a back-channel signal to Liverpool, which is exactly the kind of unverifiable insider sourcing transfer reporters trade in. The original note overreaches by treating Romano's 'no Liverpool approach' line as a debunk of a different claim (reps informing Liverpool of Chelsea's interest). It is a framing dispute over a low-stakes rumor, not a factual misrepresentation a reader needs corrected.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. This is a routine transfer-rumor tweet from an aggregator account. Any note here is a false positive — the claim is unverifiable insider sourcing, the consequences are trivial sports gossip, and the original (NOT_HELPFUL) note over-applied Romano's quote to debunk a slightly different claim. FAIL any note that asserts Liverpool has not been contacted by Alonso's reps (that's an unverifiable negative).

original_unhelpful_note.text: The claim that Xabi Alonso's representatives informed Liverpool of Chelsea's interest is not reported by reputable sources. Transfer expert Fabrizio Romano states Liverpool have not approached Alonso's camp recently. https://www.anfieldwatch.co.uk/liverpool-fc/news/fabrizio-romano-shares-latest-on-massive-xabi-alonso-to-liverpool-story
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: note_not_needed_on_transfer_rumor; conflates 'Liverpool not approaching Alonso' with 'Alonso's reps not informing Liverpool', which is a different unverifiable claim

fact_check.notes: Romano in May 2026 says Liverpool has not contacted Alonso's camp and Chelsea has met Alonso directly. That doesn't disprove that Alonso's reps quietly informed Liverpool of Chelsea's interest; transfer-rumor sourcing is routinely insider and unverifiable.

importance.lens_rationale: Sports transfer gossip; negligible EA/progress/safety stakes.
